articles.title: Bybit will look for big broker partnerships to take on Robinhood in the U.S.
articles.snippet: When it comes to the U.S., Bybit will look to work with with someone like Interactive Brokers (IB), for example, said CEO Ben Zhou.

articles.title: OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo calls corporate objections a ‘natural response’ to tokenized stock plans
articles.snippet: The former NY governor, who co-chairs the joint venture between the crypto exchange and Intercontinental Exchange, said companies were expected to take a wait-and-see approach.

articles.title: PancakeSwap TVL tops $380M as major fee overhaul heads to vote
articles.snippet: PancakeSwap’s proposed fee-sharing overhaul would give liquidity providers 88% of swap fees and cut CAKE emissions by 69%, as BNB Chain’s DeFi activity expands.

articles.title: Shinhan, SBI make Japan-Korea tourist spending a test case for yen stablecoins
articles.snippet: The companies will assess safeguards for travelers and whether stablecoins can speed up trade settlement between South Korea and Japan.

articles.title: Tech giants rush to block 8 eMudhra certs that could enable fake sites
articles.snippet: A private key generation flaw allowed anyone to guess them and forge HTTPS certificates for any website.
